sample_html:
Three actionable supplier candidates

Compare evidenced matching products from three distinct suppliers.

How selection works

  1. Admit evidenced product matches without a known hard conflict.
  2. Score comparable price, scoped sales, MOQ fit and current source activity; missing non-hard facts receive zero credit.
  3. Group legal, marketplace member and shop identities; keep one primary offer per supplier.
  4. Protect at most 20 suppliers within 10 product-score points of the best product.
  5. Select F5 to F0 within the protected pool; use product score within a tier and trust only as a secondary explanation.
  6. Disclose RFQ unknowns; never use a factory badge to rescue a wrong product or pad a short pool.

Product weights: price45 / sales35 / MOQ10 / freshness and active10. Source certification is not an independent SeekAPI factory audit.
